g.text: ...and what the cut rule itself costs (negative = the shipped cut wins)

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Regret decomposition, deep regime (t >= 100). Both panels are in cost units — note the different y scales.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: A negative rule inefficiency means the shipped cut beats the best threshold fitted on the sim half — so acquisition, not the cut rule, is where the remaining headroom is.
